test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: general
question: When the price of an item was reduced by 20%, its sale increased by x%. If there is an increase of 25% in receipt of the revenue, then the value of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Revenue = Price × Sale

Price Ratio (Initial : New) = 100 : 80 = 5 : 4

Revenue Ratio (Initial : New) = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5

Sale Ratio = (Revenue Ratio ÷ Price Ratio) = (4/5) : (5/4) = 16 : 25

Percentage increase in sale (x) = (Increase ÷ Initial) × 100 = (9 ÷ 16) × 100 = 56.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 56.25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Price reduction = 20%, Revenue increase = 25%

Formula: Revenue = Price × Consumption (Sale)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/043c0b073f2ab605c37683ca4a147f1a872500a49138e23b67d47cd44d8bda26.png] 

Let initial Price = 100 and initial Sale = 100

⇒ Initial Revenue = 100 × 100 = 10,000

⇒ New Price = 100 − 20% of 100 = 80

⇒ New Sale = 100 + x

⇒ New Revenue = 10,000 + 25% of 10,000 = 12,500

⇒ New Revenue = New Price × New Sale

⇒ 12,500 = 80 × (100 + x)

⇒ 100 + x = 12,500 ÷ 80

⇒ 100 + x = 156.25

⇒ x = 156.25 − 100

⇒ x = 56.25

**∴ The correct answer is 56.25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Formula

When two variables are multiplied to give a product, the net percentage change in the product is given by: a + b + (ab/100).

Price and Consumption Relationship

If the expenditure (revenue) is kept constant, the price is inversely proportional to the consumption: P₁ × C₁ = P₂ × C₂.

Fractional Equivalent

Using fractions can simplify calculations: a 20% decrease is a factor of 4/5, and a 25% increase is a factor of 5/4.</p
